cisco_webex.description:
List of Cisco WebEx notification settings.

Required fields are:
  * `recipient_id`
  * `recipient_type`

recipient_id.description: The default value is `user@example.com`.  Recipient Identifier for the WebEx Room or User, dependent on the recipient_type.
recipient_id.title: Domain Name

recipient_type.description: The default value is `roomId`.  The recipient type for the notification.
recipient_type.title: The recipient type

cisco_webex.title: Cisco WebEx Notification Settings

microsoft_teams.description:
List of Microsoft Teams notification settings.

Required fields are:
  * `enabled`

enabled.description: The default value is `true`.  Whether Microsoft Teams notifications are enabled.

microsoft_teams.title: Microsoft Teams Notification Settings

slack.description:
List of Slack notification settings.

Required fields are:
  * `enabled`

enabled.description: The default value is `true`.  Whether Slack notifications are enabled.

slack.title: Slack Notification Settings
